title: rosa pimpinellifolia subalpina
intro: Rosa pimpinellifolia subalpina, commonly known as Alpine Sweetbriar, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Rosa pimpinellifolia subalpina include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
